annotations.title: Suburb · Banking, post and emergency services

description:
Bank branches, ATMs, post offices, police stations and fire stations: counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/services`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_banks, per_1000_banks, nearest_km_banks, count_atms, per_1000_atms, nearest_km_atms, count_post_offices, per_1000_post_offices, nearest_km_post_offices, count_police_stations, per_1000_police_stations, nearest_km_police_stations, count_fire_stations, per_1000_fire_stations, nearest_km_fire_stations, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
